Class Piece

java.lang.Object
pieces.Piece
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bishop, King, Knight, Pawn, Queen, Rook
public abstract class Piece extends Object
Abstract base class representing a generic chess piece on the board. Defines shared attributes (color, position, movement history, and type symbol) and provides helper methods for calculating valid movement paths.

    • Piece

      public Piece(Color color, Position position, char typeChar)
      Constructs a Piece with the given color, starting position, and character identifier.
      Parameters:
      color - the team color of the piece (Color.WHITE or Color.BLACK)
      position - the initial position of the piece on the chessboard
      typeChar - the character representing the piece type ('p', 'R', 'N', 'B', 'Q', 'K')

  • Method Details

    • possibleMoves

      public abstract List<Position> possibleMoves(Board board)
      Calculates and returns a list of all pseudo-legal target positions this piece can move to from its current position, given the current state of the board.
      Parameters:
      board - the current chessboard state
      Returns:
      a List of valid destination Position objects

    • isValidMove

      public boolean isValidMove(Position target, Board board)
      Checks if moving this piece to the target position is valid according to its movement rules.
      Parameters:
      target - the destination coordinate to test
      board - the current chessboard state
      Returns:
      true if target is in possibleMoves(board); false otherwise

    • getSlidingMoves

      protected List<Position> getSlidingMoves(Board board, int[][] directions)
      Helper method for sliding pieces (Rook, Bishop, Queen) to collect all reachable squares along a given set of directional vectors until blocked by the board edge or another piece.
      Parameters:
      board - the current chessboard state
      directions - a 2D array of {dRow, dCol} step vectors
      Returns:
      a List of reachable Position coordinates along those directions
